messages.text: I run a small bakery. Can you make a page so I know which orders need attention?

What should make an order show up as "needs attention" on this page?
Running late (Recommended): Orders past their pickup/delivery time that haven't been marked ready yet — so your team knows what to rush.
Due soon: Orders coming up in the next hour or two, so staff can get ahead of them.
Not paid yet: Orders with outstanding payment, so staff know to collect before handoff.
Not sure — just pick something sensible: I'll start with late, unpacked orders first since that's usually the most urgent for a bakery.
